classification.difficultyReason: Requires recognising useful groups in a sum of thirteen fractions without a calculator.

content.prompt:
Without using your calculator, find the sum of the numbers in this list. Hint: Think carefully about the order in which you add them.

$$\frac17,\frac18,\frac19,\frac1{10},\frac1{11},\frac1{12},\frac1{14},\frac1{15},\frac1{18},\frac1{22},\frac1{24},\frac1{28},\frac1{33}.$$

answer.short:
$1$.

Group fractions with related denominators, then add the simplified group sums.
answer.worked:
Group fractions with related denominators:

$$\begin{align*}\frac17+\frac1{14}+\frac1{28}&=\frac{4+2+1}{28}=\frac14\\\frac18+\frac1{24}&=\frac{3+1}{24}=\frac16\\\frac19+\frac1{18}&=\frac{2+1}{18}=\frac16\\\frac1{10}+\frac1{15}&=\frac{3+2}{30}=\frac16\\\frac1{11}+\frac1{22}+\frac1{33}&=\frac{6+3+2}{66}=\frac16\end{align*}$$

The remaining term is $\frac1{12}$. Hence the sum is

$$\begin{align*}\frac14+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac1{12}&=\frac14+\frac46+\frac1{12}\\\frac14+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac1{12}&=\frac3{12}+\frac8{12}+\frac1{12}\\\frac14+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac16+\frac1{12}&=1.\end{align*}$$
